2124953476216365106.en_summary: TedHZhang asks why he said exit liquidity. Basically every single AI infra name is trading near lows of the day. Can't find one trading 50% of its daily range. Quoted earlier post: smells like exit liquidity from pods and hedge funds liquidating last Thu/Fri, still positions to unwind, Anthropic just IPOed, markets needed liquidity and reinstating Jensen was best way. Takes back if $SPY $QQQ reclaim rising 30/40-week MAs and see proliferation of growth leadership groups.
2124953476216365106.zh_summary: TedHZhang 問為何說退出流動性。基本上每個 AI 基礎設施名稱都在交易日低點附近交易。找不到一個交易其每日範圍 50% 的名稱。引用較早帖文：聞起來像退出流動性，來自上週四/五對衝基金清算，仍有許多倉位需平倉，Anthropic 剛 IPO，市場需要流動性，復職 Jensen 是最佳方式。若 $SPY $QQQ 重新奪回上升的 30/40 週均線並看到成長領導群組擴散，則收回之前說法。

Possible this is a bounce and not a full-blown sentiment shift.
